image_description: A high-angle shot of a wooden cutting board featuring two meat cleavers. The top cleaver is new, with a yellow protective paper wrapper covering the upper part of the blade and handle area, showing some text and graphics. The bottom cleaver is older, with a heavily worn, pitted, or stained metal surface on the flat side of the blade. Both blades are rectangular with thick spines, resting parallel to each other.
